name: build-slice
context_rationale: build-slice requires interactive plan-mode approval gates, mid-slice smoke-gate user halts, and continuous milestone.json updates during execution — all of which depend on the live conversation thread.
summary: Executes the current slice end-to-end using plan mode plus a sequence of verification gates. The Builder enters plan mode to explore code with code-review-graph queries and targeted Reads, drafts a task sequence, and obtains explicit user approval before writing code. Execution proceeds task-by-task with per-task verification, a mandatory mid-slice smoke gate, and a multi-audit pre-finish gate before declaring the slice done. Outputs build-log.json and hands off to /code-review.

methodology_tools.name: wt_root_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: WT-ROOT-1 enforcement (Step 6 pre-finish): asserts slice code lives in the worktree $wt and the main tree is clean (no edits leaked out of $wt). Shared with /validate-slice.

methodology_tools.name: critique_review_prerequisite_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: CRP-1 gate: verifies critique-review.md is present before build entry and again at pre-finish.

methodology_tools.name: _worktree_paths
methodology_tools.purpose: Computes canonical worktree path and branch name from the single shared source.

methodology_tools.name: drift_check_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: DCE-1 gate: verifies /drift-check full-mode appended a slice-referencing trigger line to drift-log.md.

methodology_tools.name: branch_workflow_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: BRANCH-1 gate: verifies commits live on the correct slice/NNN branch.

methodology_tools.name: utf8_stdout_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: UTF8-STDOUT-1 gate: verifies every tools/*.py main() reconfigures stdout to UTF-8.

methodology_tools.name: pipeline_chain_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: PCA-1 gate: verifies every covered pipeline skill carries a well-formed Pipeline position block.

methodology_tools.name: build_checks_integrity
methodology_tools.purpose: BCI-1 gate: asserts live build-checks.md files match git-tracked canonical fixtures.

methodology_tools.name: state_transition_pin_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: STP-1 gate: detects stale test pins referencing old skill prose or outdated risk-register status values.

methodology_tools.name: new_agent_warning_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: NAW-1 gate: warns if any agents/*.md were added in this slice's diff.

methodology_tools.name: test_first_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: TF-1 gate: verifies every AC maps to a PASSING test when Test-first is declared.

methodology_tools.name: build_checks_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: BC-1 gate: reads build-checks.md, filters applicable rules, refuses if any Critical rule unacknowledged under --strict.

methodology_tools.name: wiring_matrix_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: WIRE-1 gate: verifies design.md includes a wiring matrix with consumer entry point and test for every new module.

methodology_tools.name: mock_budget_lint
methodology_tools.purpose: LINT-MOCK gate: lints test files for mock-budget violations, escalating cross-chunk-seam targets to Critical.

methodology_tools.name: skill_vault_write_safety_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: SVW-1 gate: verifies every SKILL.md directive mutating a shared-aggregate vault file routes through vault_edit append.

external_tools.name: code-review-graph
external_tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
external_tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Discover file paths during plan-mode exploration.

harness_tools.name: Grep

harness_tools.name: Edit

name: validate-slice
context_rationale: validate-slice works entirely from file inputs (mission-brief.json, build-log.json, shippability.json) and tool invocations against the live environment; it has no dependency on prior conversation state beyond those artifact files.
summary: Validates the current slice against real environments — real device, real user, real data — going beyond test-suite passing. For each acceptance criterion it executes real-world checks, captures evidence, and classifies results as PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL with failure cause. It runs a shippability catalog regression check via shippability_runner, preceded by SCMD-1, PTFCD-1, and SVW-1 pre-catalog gates plus VAL-1, WS-1, ETC-1 layered audits before handing off to /reflect.

methodology_tools.name: wt_root_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: WT-ROOT-1 pre-catalog gate: asserts the slice's code (fix + repro test) is in the worktree $wt and the main tree is clean before running the shippability catalog from $wt. Shared with /build-slice.

methodology_tools.name: validate_slice_layers
methodology_tools.purpose: VAL-1 gate: Layer A credential scan (Critical) and Layer B Python dependency hallucination check (Important).

methodology_tools.name: walking_skeleton_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: WS-1 gate: verifies every architectural layer was EXERCISED at runtime when Walking-skeleton declared.

methodology_tools.name: exploratory_charter_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: ETC-1 gate: verifies every charter is COMPLETED or DEFERRED with findings recorded.

methodology_tools.name: shippability_decoupling_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: SCMD-1 pre-catalog gate: verifies every catalog row carries a prose-free Machine-cmd column.

methodology_tools.name: shippability_path_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: PTFCD-1 pre-catalog gate: verifies every tests/*.py token in Machine-cmd cells resolves to a file on disk.

methodology_tools.name: skill_vault_write_safety_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: SVW-1 pre-catalog gate: verifies no SKILL.md prescribes an unrouted mutation of a shared-aggregate vault file.

methodology_tools.name: shippability_runner
methodology_tools.purpose: SRSC-1 canonical catalog runner: executes each row's Machine-cmd and reports PASS/FAIL to catch regressions.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Load mission-brief.json, build-log.json, and shippability.json as inputs.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Create validation.json with per-criterion results, evidence, shippability regression notes.

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Update milestone.json with validation stage, result, next-action.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Execute real-world checks per AC (curl, pytest, CLI runs) and invoke all audit tools.

file_access.purpose: Primary input: acceptance criteria, verification plan, Walking-skeleton/Exploratory-charter flags.
Confirm the slice was SHIPPED and interpret deviations during AC validation.
Primary output: per-criterion PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL with evidence and shippability regression notes.
Updated to record stage: validate, result, next-action.
Shippability catalog read and executed via canonical runner to check for regressions.
Reality surprises discovered during validation appended immediately via scripts.lib.vault_edit append (SVW-1).

Append reality-surprise findings that spawn future work as new candidates.
